name: Memories of Phantasm Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

This mod adds in several Touhou fan songs from various artists/circles on my Youtube playlist. the ost is mixed ensuring a different song each time you load up.

Install Instructions: Drag BepinEx folder into your SPT directory. All credit goes to the artists/circles for their amazing music.
